data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): The db-case prose MUST instruct the decomposer to INFER destructiveness (safe-revert vs compensating-forward) from the change DESCRIPTION / file-impact content (DROP COLUMN/TABLE, NOT NULL backfill, type narrowing → destructive → compensating-forward; pure additive → safe-revert), and state explicitly that the marker does NOT carry destructiveness — migration-class-detect.sh classifies db purely by file pattern and emits only the literal 'db'. Without this the classification rule is inert (every db change falls to one default). Verify: grep -iE 'destructive|additive' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qiE 'description|change|content|infer'
